In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call 911. For less severe cases, contact a poison control center without delay. U.S. residents can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. 3. If you miss a dose of your medication, take the next dose with your next meal or snack as directed. Do not double up on doses to make up for the missed one. 4. Store the medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Avoid storing it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Dispose of expired or unused medication properly. 5. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete and personalized medical advice. 6. If you are using the tablet form of this medication, do not keep it in your mouth, as this can cause irritation to the gums and cheeks. Swallow the medication with water. 7. Do not switch brands or dosage forms of this product without consulting your doctor or pharmacist. 8. Common side effects may include diarrhea, abdominal pain or cramps, and nausea. If your doctor has prescribed this medication, they have determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. Serious allergic reactions to this drug are rare. Contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. 9. Before taking this digestive enzyme, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to pork protein, or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. 10. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly needed. It is not known whether this drug passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor for guidance. 11. Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. 12.
